# Genome Evolution Design System

> This repository provides component documentation, design foundations, design tokens, composition patterns, AI usage guidance, and a React implementation to support consistent interface generation.

Use Figma as the source of truth for intended visual design. Use repository documentation and implementation resources to understand component usage, design-system conventions, available tokens, and technical constraints.

## Start Here

- [README](README.md): General overview, repository structure, and usage guidance.
- [Agent Instructions](AGENTS.md): Workflow and source-of-truth rules for AI agents.
- [Component Manifest](manifest.json): Structured component inventory, metadata, variants, and documentation paths.

## Component Documentation

- [Component Catalog](components/): Component purpose, anatomy, properties, variants, states, and usage guidance.
- [Spanish Component Documentation](components/es/): Spanish versions of component documentation.

## Design Foundations

- [Foundations](foundations/): Color, typography, spacing, borders, opacity, elevation, and layout.

## Design Tokens

- [Token Package](packages/tokens/): Design token source and package resources.

## Composition Patterns

- [Patterns](patterns/): Documented patterns for combining components.

## Documentation Templates

- [Documentation Templates](templates/): Templates intended to support the creation and organization of component documentation. Assess their suitability before reuse; they are not guaranteed to be fully verified or up to date.

## React Implementation

- [React Package](packages/react/): Implementation resources for understanding available components, properties, and technical constraints.

## Additional AI Guidance

Consult relevant files under `ai/` when they exist and apply to the task, such as component selection rules, token usage rules, invalid combinations, evaluation checklists, or prompt guidance.

This file is an entry point to repository resources. It does not replace `AGENTS.md` or the detailed sources it references.
